motion_classes.label: Hinged swing
motion_classes.description: Leaf rotates about a vertical axis at its edge: butt, continuous, strap, spring, cam-lift or crane hinges.  The default door of every building code (ANSI/BHMA A156.1 / EN 1935 hinges).

families.label: Swing (single)
families.description: Single-leaf hinged door (residential, commercial, fire, institutional, industrial, security, storefront)
families.robot: The reference problem: locate and operate the operator (lever, knob, panic bar, pull), overcome latch preload and closer spring, keep the body clear of the swing, hold a self-closing leaf while passing, re-latch on close.  Handing (left/right), push/pull side and lock state change the whole plan.

variants.label: Residential interior
variants.description: Bedroom, bathroom, closet and hallway doors: hollow-core slabs, knobs and levers, privacy locks, no closer.

variants.label: Residential exterior
variants.description: Entry, back and side doors incl. screen / storm doors: deadbolts, handlesets, keypads, weather seals.

variants.label: Commercial office
variants.description: Office, conference, corridor and restroom doors: grade-1 levers, deadlatches, surface closers, access control.

variants.label: Fire / egress
variants.description: Rated hollow-metal doors in the means of egress: exit devices, closers, smoke seals, delayed egress.

variants.label: Institutional
variants.description: Hospital, school, lab, hotel, radiology and behavioural-health doors.

variants.label: Industrial / utility
variants.description: Mechanical, electrical, warehouse and roof-access doors: padlocks, louvers, worn hardware.

variants.label: Storefront glass
variants.description: Aluminium storefront and frameless glass doors on pivots with floor springs and pull bars.

variants.label: Heritage / rustic
variants.description: Plank, brace and carved doors with Suffolk latches, rim locks, strap hinges.

variants.label: Security / detention
variants.description: Cell, sally-port, evidence and armory doors: 14 ga steel, bar grilles, heavy hinges.

families.label: Swing (pair)
families.description: Pair of hinged leaves (french, commercial pair w/ panic hardware, double egress, storefront pair)
examples: auditorium exit pair with vertical rods
families.robot: Which leaf is active?  Inactive leaves are held by flush bolts, cane bolts or a removable mullion; double-egress leaves swing opposite ways; the clear opening may need both leaves; vertical-rod devices latch top and bottom.

variants.label: Commercial panic pair
variants.description: Egress pairs with rim / vertical-rod exit devices, closers, removable mullions.

variants.label: French pair
variants.description: Glazed residential pairs: one active leaf, flush bolts on the inactive leaf, optional cremone bolt.

variants.label: Storefront pair
variants.description: Entrance pairs in aluminium / frameless glass with floor springs and ladder pulls.

variants.label: Double egress
variants.description: Cross-corridor pairs whose leaves swing in opposite directions (hospital, airport, mall smoke doors).

variants.label: Barn pair
variants.description: Hinged barn and carriage-house pairs on strap hinges with cane bolts and slide bolts.

families.label: Dutch
families.description: Dutch door: independently hinged upper & lower halves with joining bolt
families.robot: Two independently hinged halves joined by a bolt: with the bolt thrown the door behaves as one leaf, otherwise only the upper half opens; the lower half must be opened separately to pass.

variants.label: Residential
variants.description: Home setting.

families.label: Saloon
families.description: Double-acting spring-hinged leaves swinging both ways (cafe / saloon / kitchen pass)
families.robot: No latch and no operator: push through in either direction against the spring hinges and stay clear of the return swing, which can strike the robot from behind.

variants.label: Hospitality
variants.description: Cafes, restaurants, bars, supermarkets.

families.label: Automatic swing
families.description: Automatic swing operators (low-energy push-to-open / full-energy)
families.robot: Press the wall button or wave, or start the swing by hand (push-and-go); the operator then swings and holds the leaf; unpowered it behaves as a heavy closer.  Card readers and maglocks sit on the same doors.

variants.label: Institutional
variants.description: Hospital, school, lab, hotel, radiology and behavioural-health doors.

variants.label: Commercial office
variants.description: Office, conference, corridor and restroom doors: grade-1 levers, deadlatches, surface closers, access control.

variants.label: Storefront glass
variants.description: Aluminium storefront and frameless glass doors on pivots with floor springs and pull bars.

families.label: Cold storage
families.description: Walk-in cooler / freezer doors (cam-lift hinges, gasket, inside release)
standards: industry hardware: Kason 1245 cam-lift hinges, Kason 58 SafeGuard latch
families.robot: Cam-lift hinges raise the leaf as it opens (self-closing by gravity), a magnetic gasket holds it shut, the SafeGuard handle needs a pull-and-lift; an inside release must always work.

families.label: Toilet stall
families.description: Toilet partition stall door (gravity hinge, slide latch)
standards: manufacturer hardware (Bobrick gravity hinges, slide latches)
families.robot: Gravity hinges hold the door ajar when vacant; an occupied stall is latched from inside with a slide latch and must be recognised as such; narrow leaf and pilaster gap.

families.label: Gate (swing)
families.description: Outdoor swing gates: picket, chain-link, wrought iron, pool, ranch
standards: ISPSC §305 / ASTM F1908 pool barriers (self-closing, self-latching, latch at 1.37 m)
families.robot: Outdoor: uneven ground clearance, sagging hinges, gravity latches that must be lifted, hasps and padlocks, pool latches mounted at 1.5 m out of a child's reach; wide farm gates swing through large arcs.

variants.label: Garden picket
variants.description: Cedar picket gates with Suffolk or fork latches and gate springs.

variants.label: Chain-link
variants.description: Galvanised frame + mesh with fork latches, hasps and padlocks.

variants.label: Wrought iron
variants.description: Ornamental gates with mortise locks, deadbolts or electric strikes.

variants.label: Ranch tube
variants.description: Wide galvanised tube gates with slide bolts, chains and padlocks.

variants.label: Pool safety
variants.description: Self-closing, self-latching gates with a magnetic latch at 1.5 m (pool code).

families.label: Baby gate
families.description: Pressure- or hardware-mounted child safety gate
standards: ASTM F1004 (expansion gates and expandable enclosures)
families.robot: A lift-and-swing latch designed to defeat toddlers, a trip bar at floor level, spring return; the robot can also step over it.

families.label: Watertight (marine)
families.description: Marine watertight door with dogging levers or central wheel
families.robot: Release 4-8 wedge dogs one by one (or spin a central handwheel on quick-acting doors), pull a 64-120 kg leaf off a compressed gasket, step over a 150-450 mm coaming, re-dog behind.

families.label: Vault
families.description: Vault / safe-room door with handwheel boltwork
families.robot: Turn a handwheel one to two full turns to retract 4-8 bolts, then move a tonne of steel on crane hinges: high inertia, very low friction, a step sill.

families.label: Blast door
families.description: Blast door (very heavy, multi-hinge, lever bolts)
families.robot: Like a vault door but latched by lever dogs or a wheel; heavy gaskets and a raised sill.

motion_classes.label: Pivot
motion_classes.description: Leaf rotates about a vertical axis inset from its edge on floor / head pivots (ANSI/BHMA A156.4 floor closers, A156.17 pivots); oversized architectural leaves.

families.label: Pivot (architectural)
families.description: Pivot door: center or offset floor pivot, often oversized / heavy
families.robot: Heavy leaf (56-262 kg) on a centre or offset pivot: part of the leaf swings towards the robot while the rest swings away; the floor spring's hold-open at 90 deg and large inertia dominate.

motion_classes.label: Sliding
motion_classes.description: Leaf translates along the wall on rollers or hangers: pocket, surface (barn), patio, shoji, bypass, automatic, hoistway.

families.label: Sliding
families.description: Single sliding leaf: pocket, barn (surface track), patio glass, shoji/fusuma, cell, industrial
examples: barn door on a flat track
standards: ANSI/BHMA A156.14 sliding & folding door hardware
IBC §1010.1.2 (sliding doors not in egress except auto)
families.robot: Grasp a flush pull or edge and translate the leaf along its track against roller friction; a hook lock or teardrop latch must be lifted first; the leaf disappears into a pocket or behind a fixed panel so the grasp point moves.

variants.label: Barn (surface track)
variants.description: Surface-mounted flat track with hangers; floor guide, teardrop privacy latch.

variants.label: Pocket
variants.description: Leaf disappears into the wall; flush pulls and hook locks.

variants.label: Patio glass
variants.description: Bottom-rolling insulated glass leaf beside a fixed panel; hook lock with thumb latch.

variants.label: Shoji / fusuma
variants.description: Paper-and-lattice panels sliding wood on wood in kamoi / shikii grooves.

variants.label: Cell / industrial
variants.description: Detention cell sliders, industrial sliding fire doors, cold-room sliders, freight-elevator manual gates.

families.label: Bypass closet
families.description: Two or three overlapping leaves on parallel tracks (closet, mirrored, shoji pair)
families.robot: Leaves overlap: only one track's leaf can be moved from a given side, and moving one leaf can uncover or cover the other; finger cups give little purchase.

families.label: Automatic sliding
families.description: Sensor-activated sliding doors (single / bi-parting) with manual breakout
families.robot: The door opens itself when the sensor fires: approach into the detection zone, wait, pass before hold-open time expires; if the power is off, break out the leaf manually (220 N).

families.label: Gate (sliding)
families.description: Cantilever / track sliding vehicle & pedestrian gates
families.robot: Long, heavy leaves (up to 330 kg) on cantilever rollers: large start force, long travel, pinch zones at the posts.

families.label: Elevator
families.description: Elevator landing doors (center or side opening, interlocked)
standards: ASME A17.1 / CSA B44 (hoistway door interlocks)
families.robot: The robot cannot open a hoistway door: it presses the call button, waits for the car, and passes during the door-open dwell; doors reopen on obstruction.

motion_classes.label: Folding
motion_classes.description: Several hinged panels fold against each other while a guided free edge translates in a track (bifold, accordion / concertina).

families.label: Bifold
families.description: Bi-fold closet doors (2 or 4 panels) pivoting with guided free edge
families.robot: Pulling the knob rotates the pivot panel while the guide panel's free edge slides in the head track: a closed kinematic chain whose panels fold towards the robot.

families.label: Accordion
families.description: Accordion / concertina folding partition door
families.robot: Many light panels on piano hinges concertina together; the pull travels the whole opening width and the stack can jam.

motion_classes.label: Overhead
motion_classes.description: Large leaf that lifts overhead: sectional on vertical + horizontal tracks with a torsion-spring counterbalance, or one-piece tilt-up on offset pivots (DASMA 102, EN 13241).

families.label: Garage (sectional)
families.description: Overhead sectional garage door (vertical lift approximated)
families.robot: Lift a 2.4-5.5 m wide, 55-190 kg leaf from a low handle: the torsion-spring counterbalance carries most of the weight but a slack or disengaged opener changes the force; the leaf moves overhead towards the robot.

families.label: Garage (tilt-up)
families.description: One-piece tilt-up garage door (offset pivot)
families.robot: The whole panel swings out at the bottom before it rises overhead, sweeping the approach area; extension springs counterbalance.

motion_classes.label: Roll-up
motion_classes.description: Coiling curtain of interlocking slats or a grille winding onto a barrel above the opening (ANSI/DASMA 108, EN 13241).

families.label: Roll-up
families.description: Roll-up / coiling steel curtain or grille
families.robot: Lift the bottom bar of a curtain that coils overhead; manual curtains need a strong pull to start (counterbalance, slat friction) and chain hoists need many turns.

motion_classes.label: Rotary
motion_classes.description: Compartmented rotor turning continuously about a vertical axis: revolving doors (ANSI/BHMA A156.27), tripod and full-height turnstiles (EN 17352, IBC 1010.3).

families.label: Revolving
families.description: Revolving door: 3 or 4 wings on a central rotor inside a drum
examples: office tower / hotel / department store revolving door
airport and hospital lobby revolving doors
families.robot: Enter a moving compartment, keep pace with the wing (speed governor), and exit on the far side without touching the drum; breakout wings and a possible electric bolt at night.

families.label: Tripod turnstile
families.description: Waist-high tripod turnstile (ratcheting rotor)
families.robot: Present a credential, then push a waist-high arm that ratchets one way; the next arm rises into the path.  One-way and drop-arm variants.

families.label: Full-height turnstile
families.description: Full-height rotating turnstile (3-4 wing rotor in cage)
families.robot: Walk inside a rotating cage compartment while pushing the bars; the rotor indexes 90-120 deg per passage and cannot be reversed.

motion_classes.label: Hatches & flaps
motion_classes.description: Leaf rotates about a horizontal axis: floor and ceiling hatches lifted against gravity, pet flaps swinging both ways on a top pin.

families.label: Floor hatch
families.description: Floor hatch / cellar trapdoor (horizontal hinge, lift up)
families.robot: Lift a horizontal leaf against gravity from a ring pull, hold it past its balance point or onto a prop arm; gas struts assist; the robot stands next to the leaf's own edge.

families.label: Ceiling hatch
families.description: Ceiling / attic hatch, roof scuttle (push up)
families.robot: Overhead push at 2.4 m; passing through needs a ladder, so the realistic task is open / close only.

families.label: Pet door
families.description: Standalone pet door flap in a wall/door panel (dog & cat sizes)
examples: cat flap in a back door
large-dog flap in a wall or garage door
standards: no code; manufacturer size classes (small / medium / large / XL)
families.robot: Too small for a humanoid: a flap swinging both ways on a top pin with a weak magnet, sometimes closed by a slide-in locking panel.  Relevant for quadrupeds and for recognising a non-passable opening.

motion_classes.label: Flexible
motion_classes.description: No rigid leaf: overlapping PVC strips hanging from a rail, pushed aside by the body.

families.label: Strip curtain
families.description: PVC strip curtain doorway (many hinged strips)
families.robot: Deformable strips that wrap around the body and obscure vision; no mechanism, but contact along the whole body.

variants.label: Industrial
variants.description: Warehouses, docks, food processing.
